title: Chief Risk Officer
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: risk and compliance are independent second-line functions reporting to the CRO.

title: Head of Credit Risk
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: risk is an independent second-line function, while the credit-risk scenario itself remains synthetic.

title: Head of Payments
source_basis: Synthetic role; calibrated to the reference three-lines model in which business teams own day-to-day risk.

title: Head of Digital Banking
source_basis: Synthetic role; calibrated to a digital-bank operating model.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: security is a second-line oversight function within the operational-risk framework.

title: Chief Information Officer
source_basis: Synthetic role; reference annual report discloses material technology operations and technical spend.

title: Third-Party Risk Management Lead
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: third-party risk includes due diligence, onboarding, monitoring, exit planning and contingency planning.

title: Head of Compliance
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: compliance is an independent second-line function.

title: Chief Operating Officer
source_basis: Synthetic role; first line is accountable for managing the risks it takes.

title: Head of Treasury
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: treasury executes first-line market-risk management under ALCO oversight.

title: Head of Internal Audit
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: internal audit independently assures first- and second-line control design and effectiveness.

title: Business Continuity Officer
source_basis: Reference-calibrated: the BCO coordinates incident escalation, recovery playbooks and resilience testing.
